# Rich copy: bold, italics and links survive the paste

Select all (Ctrl+A), copy (Ctrl+C) and paste into Outlook, Word or a web
mail. The **bold words** stay bold, *italic words* italic, web links
links and lists lists; everything else pastes as it reads.

## Message

Dear team,

**Please review the attached garden plan** before the next meeting.
The main items are **A12** and **B7+3**.

A bold span that **wraps across a soft
line break** stays one span, *italic* stays italic, [a link](https://example.com)
stays a link, and [a heading link](#message) pastes as its text. Mixed:
***bold italic*** and **[a bold link](https://example.org/?a=1&b=2)**.
Escapes: **a < b & c > d** and "quotes".

**Please let me know in writing,**

- whether the **north bed** can be planted,
- which **watering schedule** applies and
- which paths must stay clear.

In order:

1. Dig the bed.
2. Water it.
   - morning
   - evening
3. Mulch.

- [x] seeds bought
- [ ] tools cleaned

* Buy groceries
* [x] Buy milk
* Drive home

+ First
+
+ Third

Numbers around a task:

1. Book
2. [x] Pay
3. Go

Tasks under an item:

1. Plan
   - [x] measured
   - [ ] fenced
2. Plant

> Quoted text with **bold inside** the quote.

| Bed | Status |
|-----|--------|
| **A12** | ready |
| B7 | check |

Inline code: **`bold code`** and `plain code`.

```text
Code blocks copy as they read, **not bold**.
```

Best regards, with accents: **Café naïve**.
